title: James Mason (GTM RevOps leader) — Incorruptible's macro guardrails vs. Greg Head's pragmatic playbook
summary: James Mason — GTM RevOps leader writing about governance and execution tension for PE-backed companies — publishes a synthesis pairing Incorruptible's macro side (mission-driven guardrails, structural governance, protecting integrity against short-term profit pressure) with Greg Head's pragmatic side (tactical execution, eliminating value leaks, repeatable systems).
blockquote: Eric Ries (in Incorruptible) focuses on the macro side, emphasizing the necessity of mission driven guardrails, structural governance, and protecting institutional integrity against short term profit pressures. Greg Head focuses on the pragmatic side, detailing the tactical, ground truth execution required to stabilize operations, eliminate value leaks, and build repeatable systems in high pressure environments.
